description: Luxurious 3BR apartment steps from the Champs-Élysées. Recently renovated, featuring 1 queen bed and 3 single beds. The 3rd bedroom, located in the attic, doubles as a workspace and includes a bed. Fully equipped kitchen and 2 elegant bathrooms offer comfort and style. Situated in a lively neighborhood with restaurants and shops, perfect for exploring Paris. Ideal for families or groups seeking a chic, central stay.The spaceThis luxurious 3-bedroom apartment is perfectly situated just steps from the iconic Champs-Élysées, offering the ultimate Parisian experience. Located on the 3rd floor of a building without a lift, the climb is well worth it for the comfort and convenience you'll find inside. Recently renovated, the apartment combines modern amenities with classic elegance, ensuring a stylish stay. It features 1 queen bed and 3 single beds, making it ideal for families or groups of friends.A unique feature of the apartment is the 3rd bedroom, located in the attic, which serves as both a cozy sleeping area and a functional workspace. Whether you need a quiet place to work or relax, this loft area provides flexibility and charm.The apartment boasts a fully equipped kitchen with everything you need to prepare meals during your stay, from appliances to utensils, perfect for those who enjoy cooking. The two elegantly designed bathrooms provide convenience and a touch of luxury, with high-quality fixtures and a fresh, modern look.Situated in a vibrant neighborhood full of trendy restaurants, cafés, and boutique shops, you'll have everything at your doorstep.
